def count_Substrings(s: str) -> int:
    prefix_sum = 0
    count_map = {0: 1}  # prefix sum 0 has occurred once before any element
    count = 0
    
    for ch in s:
        # Subtract 1 from each digit so condition becomes sum == 0
        prefix_sum += int(ch) - 1
        
        # If this prefix sum has been seen before, each previous occurrence
        # gives a substring with sum of (digit-1) == 0
        count += count_map.get(prefix_sum, 0)
        
        # Record this prefix sum occurrence
        count_map[prefix_sum] = count_map.get(prefix_sum, 0) + 1
    
    return count
